title: perf(console): the first load stops downloading the Setup pages, the package form and the view config panel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1jBgfsH7uDVYbZzMpqyqUL)_

Fixes #33293

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#2` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5mmCUzPNeT1C9cHRtT` · claim 6886542738

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台首次加载不再预先下载 Setup 里的几个页面(软件包、软件包表单、权限集矩阵编辑器、打包动作、连接器凭据与连接、岗位成员、权限集分配、回收站)和列表视图的「视图配置」侧栏;它们改为第一次打开时才下载。仪表盘等任何路由的首屏脚本从 2,293,387 字节(gzip)降到 2,163,689 字节,少了约 130 KB(5.7%)。
- 为什么改:#33293 测得慢网络冷缓存下仪表盘要等 2.29 MB 首屏脚本下完才开始取数;其中有不少是仪表盘根本不画的代码。卡上点名的 `PackageFormDialog` 块已整块离开首屏。
- 风险与回滚:只改加载时机,不改任何页面画什么。Setup 页面首次打开时多一行「Loading …」提示,视图配置侧栏在列表挂载时才下载(管理员打开它之前已到)。卡上另外点名的 `plugin-grid`、`plugin-form`、`RecordDetailView`、Studio 英文语言包仍在首屏,原因与拆分建议见 Acceptance notes。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx(新增 `lazyPage`,八个页面改成按需加载)、ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx(`ViewConfigPanel` 改为 `lazy()` 加 `Suspense`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build` 后在 `ui/apps/console` 跑 `CI=true pnpm exec vite build`,读 `dist/eager-closure.json` 的 `eagerGzipBytes`,应为约 2,163,689;打开 `/apps/setup/component/developer/packages`,页面正常画出。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Measured first, on `origin/main` `e3f0cfd4`: `CI=true pnpm exec vite build` in `ui/apps/console` wrote `dist/eager-closure.json` = **105 eager chunks of 2427, 2,293,387 B gzip** (7,730,755 raw). The card's 2,286,732 B is the published 18.4.0 Console; same shape. The import edge that makes each named chunk eager was read from the build's own module graph (the console's `vite.config.ts` run through Vite's `build()` with one read-only plugin that dumps `getModuleInfo()` and each chunk's module list; that build wrote the same `eager-closure.json` to the byte). The edges are tabled under Acceptance notes.

Two edges are cut here, both by `lazy()` with the `Suspense` boundary inside what is rendered:

- **`services/builtinComponents.tsx`**, the app-shell module the package entry bare-imports for its registrations, imported eight pages BY VALUE: `PackagesPage`, `PermissionMatrixEditPage`, `PackagedActionsPage`, `ConnectorCredentialsPage`, `ConnectorConnectionsPage`, `PositionHoldersPage`, `PermissionSetAssignmentPage`, `RecycleBinPage`. Each, with everything it imports, sat in the eager closure; `PackagesPage → PackageFormDialog` is the card's `PackageFormDialog` edge, and `PositionHoldersPage → PositionHoldersSection` held a 25.8 KB chunk. A new `lazyPage(label, load)` returns a component that renders the page behind `lazy()` + `Suspense`, the shape the file's two metadata-admin registrations already use, so `registerAppComponent` and `registerMetadataResource` still receive a component and no render site changes. The fallback is the file's existing `MetadataAdminFallback` ("Loading packages…").
- **`views/ObjectView.tsx`** imported `ViewConfigPanel` statically. `ObjectView` is in AppContent's always-eager block, so the panel held `ViewVariantInspector`, `SchemaForm`, the Studio form widgets (`widgets.tsx`, `ConditionBuilder`, `CelPredicateField`) and `RuntimeDraftBar` eager. It is now `lazy()` inside a `Suspense` boundary whose fallback is `null`, in the same wrapper div. The panel draws nothing while closed, so the list draws exactly as before; its chunk is requested as the list mounts.

Result, `30cbab20` (same instrument): **107 eager chunks of 2487, 2,163,689 B gzip** (7,271,631 raw), **−129,698 B (−5.7%)**. Two builds of this tree read 2,163,688 and 2,163,689; the 1 B is build-to-build variance, not attributed.

| named chunk (card) | before, B gz | after | status |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `PackageFormDialog` | 43,854 | — | **left the eager closure** (its `SchemaForm` / `CelPredicateField` co-tenants left too; `object-fields-io`, 1,575 B, and `json-schema-to-fields`, 1,882 B, stay, see notes) |
| `plugin-grid` | 159,651 | 159,637 | eager, see notes |
| `plugin-form` | 44,269 | 44,270 | eager, see notes |
| `RecordDetailView` | 27,273 | 27,291 | eager, see notes |
| `i18n-ns-studio-en` | 64,259 | 64,259 | eager, see notes |

Also left: `PositionHoldersSection` (25,809), most of `src` (69,042 → 38,197), `field-types` (13,030), `view-schema` (5,292), `MarketplaceLanguages` (5,234), `dist` (4,845), `ViewVariantInspector`, `ViewColumnPanes`, `RuntimeDraftBar`, `_shared` and four small chunks. Sixteen small eager chunks appear (largest `metadata-form-i18n` 11,364 and `marketplaceApi` 4,065): modules that were already eager inside the chunks that left, regrouped by rolldown, ⛔ not new first-load bytes.

The eager-closure gate's ceiling does not move. `pnpm check:eager-closure` on `30cbab20`: aggregate 2113.0 KB / 2431.6 KB, headroom 318.6 KB = **0.46x** the 695.0 KB regression, so `evaluateHeadroomSensitivity`'s one predicate (headroom ≥ 1x) does not fire and the gate's rules ask for no re-pin. `BASELINE` is untouched.

Changeset `.changeset/33293-console-eager-closure-setup-pages.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch (app-shell is private; the console's `dist` ships it).

## Tests

- No test pins the eager set for these modules, so none is updated. `vite-declared-lazy-views` (build plugin) and the `ineffective-dynamic-import` ledger both pass on the new build (exit 0, "41 ineffective dynamic imports, all pinned"), so no new `import()` is defeated by a static edge elsewhere.
- **Ablation, one edge put back** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `builtinComponents.tsx`: the `PackagesPage` registration re-imported statically), rebuilt and weighed under the lock: eager closure **2,223,296 B, 112 chunks**, `PackageFormDialog` eager again; `pnpm check:eager-closure` **exit 0** (2171.2 KB, headroom 260.4 KB). Restore: blob equal to HEAD `ec73e832`, `git diff HEAD` empty. ⇒ Nothing catches an edge coming back: the gate's sensitivity is 695 KiB by ruling (objectui#12653), and a 60 KB regression is inside it. Adding a pin would be a new gate; none is added.
- Existing suites through the rendered `ObjectView` and the registrations, from `ui/` under the lock: every `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView*.test.tsx`, the four Setup `*.navContribution.test.tsx` (each mounts its page through `ComponentNavView`, now through the lazy wrapper), `ResourceListPage.positionGrants-25333`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.saveSurface-12725`, `PackagesPage.installedApps-13356`: **85 files, 662 tests passed**. `ObjectView.viewConfigSaveWiring-10210`, `ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583` and `ObjectView.createViewRefusal-11578` drive the panel through the real `ObjectView`, so the lazy panel opens and saves through the input pipeline in those pins.

## Acceptance notes

**Acceptance 1, per chunk.** Edges read from the module graph of the `30cbab20` build; "eager" = reachable from the entry chunk through static imports only.

- `plugin-grid` (159.6 KB; 73 of its modules are `plugin-detail`, which the `plugin-grid` group captures recursively because `ObjectGrid` imports it). Held by `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` (bare `import '@object-ui/plugin-grid'` and `plugin-detail`, the SDUI registration of the core views), `apps/console/src/App.tsx` → `dev/DevRowActions.tsx`, `@object-ui/plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` and `@object-ui/plugin-list`'s `ListView` (both eager the same way), and through `plugin-detail` by eleven eager app-shell modules (`sharedUserFeeds`, `deriveRelatedLists`, `workspacePreference`, `recordPagePayload`, `recordDetailSections`, `RecordPreviewCard`, …).
- `plugin-form` (44.3 KB). Held by `register-plugins.ts`, `providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` (`resolveInlineMode`), `console/AppContent.tsx` and `hooks/useActionModal.tsx` (`ModalForm`), `utils/editFormLockedByState.ts` (`filterSystemFields`, `isAutoGeneratedFieldType`), `views/ActionParamDialog.tsx` (`useInitialFieldFocus`), `views/ScreenView.tsx`, `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`, and `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView`. `plugin-form` declares only its entry side-effectful, so a named helper import keeps the whole registering entry.
- `RecordDetailView` (27.3 KB). A real static edge: `views/objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx` imports it and `ObjectView` sits in AppContent's always-eager block, the reason `ui/scripts/vite-declared-lazy-views.ts` already pins it in `DECLARED_LAZY_VIEWS_STILL_EAGER`. The chunk also carries `NotFoundState`, `recordDrawerStack` and `useObjectActions`, which `AppContent` imports directly.
- `i18n-ns-studio-en` (64.3 KB). `namespaces/studio/index.ts` imports `en.ts` statically by design (the synchronous `en` fallback, objectstack#25922), and `index.ts` is eager twice over: the `i18n-runtime` group (`/packages/i18n/`) captures it into an eager chunk, and four eager modules import app-shell's `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: `studio-design/studio-canvas-preview.tsx` (bare-imported by the package entry for its load-time `registerStudioCanvasPreview('object', …)`), `metadata-admin/datasource/register.ts` (`DatasourceResourcePage` by value), `PositionGrantCells` (by value, from `builtinComponents.tsx`), and `CreateViewDialog` → `objectDatasets` → `useDatasetCatalog`.

**Why this PR stops here (the order's split clause).** The seat filed the two remaining cuts as their own cards, #33581 (grid / form / RecordDetailView) and #33582 (the Studio `en` strings). Each remaining chunk needs a cut this card's bounds do not hold:

- **grid / form / RecordDetailView** need, together: a lazy boundary on `ObjectView` in AppContent (it is also `EAGER_WALK_CONTROL`, the positive control of `vite-declared-lazy-views`, so that plugin's counter-probe needs a new control); `register-plugins.ts`'s five eager plugins turned into `registerLazy` per tag; and side-effect-free subpaths for the helpers app-shell imports from `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/plugin-view` (`deriveRecordSurface`, `deriveRecordFlowSurface`) — a shared-package API change (new `exports` entries). Upper bound of the win: 286.7 KB gz (the five chunks' sum, part of `plugin-detail` likely staying).
- **Studio `en`** needs the default canvas preview in `studio-canvas-preview.tsx` moved to a module of its own and registered lazily (a file split of about 400 lines in a `sideEffects`-array module), `DatasourceResourcePage` and the two position cells registered lazily, `CreateViewDialog` lazy in `ObjectView`, and an `i18n-ns-studio` group in `vite.config.ts` like `i18n-ns-marketplace`. The synchronous `en` fallback stays (`en` remains a static import of the namespace module; the module itself moves out). Win: 64.3 KB gz plus `metadata-form-i18n` and the modules only those four reach.
- Two stragglers of the old `PackageFormDialog` chunk stay eager: `object-fields-io` (1,575 B, imported by `preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`) and `json-schema-to-fields` (1,882 B, via `DatasourceResourcePage`, the Studio `en` edge above).

**Acceptance 3, a built console in a real browser.** Showcase at this tree (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/example-showcase...' build`, `turbo run build:dist --filter=@objectstack/console`, then `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` from `examples/app-showcase`), headless Chromium, a fresh context (cold cache) per route, signed in as the dev admin:

| route | drew | lazy chunks seen |
|:--|:--|:--|
| dashboard `showcase_ops_dashboard` | metrics and charts, no page error | none of `ViewConfigPanel`, `PackagesPage`, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, `PackageFormDialog`, `SchemaForm` requested |
| list `showcase_task` | 10 rows | `ViewConfigPanel` requested on mount |
| record `showcase_task/record/…` | header, path, sections | — |
| Studio `/studio` | App Builder home | `PackagesPage`, `SchemaForm` fetched on demand |
| Setup → Packages | page drew | `PackagesPage`, `PackageFormDialog` fetched on demand |
| Setup → Position holders | page drew | `PositionHoldersPage` fetched on demand |
| permission set `member_default` (redirects to Studio) | matrix drew, 126 objects | `PermissionMatrixEditor` fetched on demand |

No page error, no console error, no failed request on any route. Screenshots, the probe and both `eager-closure.json` files are in the project folder `pm-orders/ui/33293-probe/`. The record and Studio rows timed out on the probe's own wait selector (a hidden first match; `main` not visible) and drew, per their screenshots. Opening the view config panel by hand needs a saved view the showcase does not seed; the rendered pins above open it. Cold/warm timing was not re-measured.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates, type-check, lint (head 30cbab20)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 30 families for this diff. All 30 exit 0 on `30cbab20`; `--ran`: 30 derived, 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` read on its rerun: the first run (beside the showcase build, `dist/` mid-rebuild) had 4 files fail on unresolvable workspace imports; alone under the lock with `--maxWorkers=2`: 171 files passed, 2 skipped, 5062 tests passed, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:eager-closure` exit 0 (above). `pnpm check:side-effects-array`, `pnpm check:sdui-registration-pins` (71 registrations present, 2492 chunks weighed), `pnpm check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0. ESLint `--no-inline-config` on the two changed source files: 0 errors (61 pre-existing warnings).
- The full app-shell suite and the rest of the farm are CI's.

</details>
